translation: If the ying-blood is internally injured and it also involves the Ren, Chong, and Hand Jueyin, then one should use Si Wu Tang (Four-Substance Decoction), Yangying Tang (Nourishing-the-Ying Decoction), Miaoxiang San (Wonderful-Fragrance Powder) and the like. Treating the disease with these medicinals accordingly — in this way, with regard to the emptiness and substance of yin and yang, one will almost not err. The Maijing of Wang Shuhe says: When the pulse at the cum-kou runs obliquely from Shaoyin to Taiyang, this is the Yang Wei vessel; in motion it causes suffering from numbness and itching of the muscles, pain of the skin, numbness of the lower parts, sweating out and [aversion to] cold; and again suffering from falling down with bleating like a goat (yang-ming), hands and feet drawn together, and in severe cases loss of voice so one cannot speak — one should take Kezhuren (Kezhuren, i.e. Shangguan, GB3).
